hooks.commandWindows: $env:PATH = (($env:PATH -split ';') -match '^(?:[A-Za-z]:[\\/]|\\\\)') -join ';'; $localPython = Join-Path $PWD.ProviderPath 'python.exe'; $python = Get-Command python.exe -CommandType Application | Where-Object { $_.Source -ne $localPython } | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$python) { throw 'python.exe was not found on PATH' }; & $python.Source -E -s -B "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\skills\use-memory\scripts\memory.py" hook SessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE
